org_thrall: Thrall, Warchief of the Horde. This is Grommash Hold, at the north-west of Orgrimmar, and the city below it was red rock when I first stood here. Three years ago the world gained people it had no names for. The Horde gave them ground to stand on, and I have not regretted it. There is a fire under this city that I do regret. Ask me about it.
org_elder_2: Torgun. I sit by the Hold because my knees chose it for me, and because the Warchief still asks what the old ones think. The Horde was not given to us. We built it, and then we had to decide who else it was for. That argument is not finished, and I keep the maps for it. Our borders are longer than they were.
org_mage_trainer: Zathyra Duskweave. I teach the arcane at the north end of the city, as far from the forges as the Warchief would allow. Magic is not given. It is taken from the raw stuff of the world, carefully, or it takes something back. Show me which of those you have been doing.
org_enchanter: Voren Glimmerhand, enchanter. My bench is beside the mage's hall on the north side, which suits us both and pleases neither. Bring me a blade and I will make it remember what it is for. Bring me things you no longer want and I will take them apart for what is in them.
org_hunter: Rethok. I teach hunters in the north-east quarter, by the stables, where the animals can hear me and the market cannot. The wilds beyond the gate do not forgive mistakes, so make yours here. And if you have the stomach for a hunt under the city, I have one I could not finish.
org_stablemaster: Kranok Wildmane. These are the north-east stables. Wolves, boars, the occasional stubborn raptor - I have broken every one of them to the saddle in the end. Leave your beast with me and it will be fed, watered and in a better temper than you when you come back.
ak_org: Morgha, Artifact Keeper. I stand by the inn so that nobody has to look for me. The same hands made every version of your set. Leave the piece with me and take the one that suits how you fight now. No charge. Keepers do not sell.
org_flight_master: Kar, windrider master. The roost is here by the inn, north of the market. Wind is good today. I fly to anywhere you have already walked to, and Orgrimmar is where most of the routes in Kalimdor end, so name it.
org_innkeeper: Gryshka. This is the inn, north of the market, beside the windrider roost. Beds are clean, ale is cold, and nobody asks where you got the blood on your boots. Want me to be your hearth?
org_shaman_trainer: Kardris Dreamseeker. I keep the shaman's fire on the west side of the city, below the Hold. The spirits of this rock were here before the walls and they have opinions about the walls. Sit. Tell me what the elements have asked of you, and I will tell you what they meant.
org_shaman_trainer_2: Sagorne Creststrider, of the tauren. I teach beside Kardris on the west side, because the Earthmother is heard in red rock as well as in grass. My people have less ground than they did. What we carried out of it, I will teach to anyone who listens properly.
org_market_trader_1: Grokka Fireforge. First stall on the north-west corner of the market, so I see everyone come down from the Hold with coin. If it is worth having I have probably got it, and if I have not, I know which stall does and I will charge you for pointing.
org_market_food: Bragok, cook. North row of the market, follow the smoke. Roasted meat and fresh bread. A warband marches on a full stomach, not on promises, and I have fed more warbands than promises have.
org_market_jewelcrafter: Fizwick Gemstone. North row, and the only stall on it with a lock. Every stone tells you something if you know how to look. Mine are all worth looking at, and one or two are worth what I am asking.
org_market_fisher: Kelgar. Old Salt, they call me, and they are right about both. North-east corner of the market. This came up from Ratchet this morning and it will not stay fresh for ever, so do not stand there deciding.
org_banker: MerchantTusk. Dis be de bank, right in de middle of de market, where everybody can watch everybody. Dere is only one bank, mon, and dere is only one me. Do not ask how dat works. Hand me ya things and go be a hero.
org_weaponsmith: Dutmar Ironjaw, weaponsmith. I work on the west side, between the market and the city forge, and I can hear Krunk hammering from here whether I want to or not. A dull blade is a liability. Bring yours to me before it gets you killed.
org_warlock_trainer: Malzhet. They call me the Bound, and they are not being unkind. I teach warlocks on the east side of the city, well away from the Hold, by arrangement. Power always costs something. I know the price better than most, and I know of someone under this city who believes he has found a way not to pay.
orgrimmar_alchemist: Zurm, apothecary. East wall, past the warlocks, which keeps the queue short. My brews are good for what ails you, mostly. Lately my customers have been bringing me an ash I did not make and do not like, and I would pay to know more about whoever did.
org_smith: Krunk Anvilfist. That is the city forge beside me and the sawmill next to it, here on the west side. Bring me ore and I will turn it into something that bites back. Bring me the black ore from under the city and I will turn it into something better than that.
org_market_herbs: Nara Greenroot. Herbs, west side of the market, second row down. Everything that grows in Kalimdor passes across this stall sooner or later, usually in a sack and usually mislabelled. Ask for it by what it does, not by what somebody told you it was called.
org_market_furrier: Bela Quickpelt, furrier. East side of the market, second row. Barrens hide, Ashenvale fur, and now and then something from further out that I price by guessing. There is a skin here for every purse.
org_warrior_trainer: They call me Grommash's Shadow, because I stood behind him and I am still standing. I train warriors on the west side, south of the forge. Strength is not the absence of fear. It is fighting on past it, and every warrior I have taught learned that the hard way, because there is no other.
org_summoning_master: Yura Emberveil. I keep the summoning circle on the east side, south of the apothecary, and I keep it swept. Summon carelessly and something comes through that you did not call. Ask me how I know. Better, do not, and learn it from me instead of from the thing.
org_market_scribe: Wexil Inkfeather, scribe. West side of the market, third row. Scrolls, contracts, letters home. Half this city cannot write and the other half should not, so whatever needs putting down, I will put it down - for a price, and spelled correctly.
org_market_relics: Ashna. Curios, third row of the market. Trinkets, oddities, and the occasional genuine relic. I sort the real from the fake, mostly. Lately people bring me things I cannot place at all, made of stuff I have no word for. Those I buy.
org_market_florist: Petal Windgrace. Third row, and yes, flowers, in Orgrimmar. Not every stall in this city needs to sell steel. Somebody has to sell what you bring home afterwards to say sorry for the steel.
org_market_spices: Kesh Farflavor. East end of the third row. Spice from Stranglethorn, salt from the Flats, pepper off the Barrens, all on one table. Taste before you buy. If your eyes water, that one is working.
org_market_baker: Fennel. Doughmaster, if you are buying. Bottom row of the market, west side. Fresh bread, fresh every morning - rain or shine or centaur raid, I bake. The oven has gone out twice since the city was built, and I was ill both times.
org_market_toys: Sprocket, tinker. Bottom row of the market, east side. Clockwork toys and harmless little gadgets. Mostly harmless. Read the label, and if it has no label, wind it up outdoors.
org_rogue_trainer: You found me, so either you are good or I let you. I teach in the south-west of the city, near where the ground goes warm, and I listen to what comes up out of it. They call that hole Ragefire Chasm. Something down there has started whispering back.
org_poison_vendor: Vexia Nightshade. South-west quarter, a short walk from the rogue trainer who pretends not to be there. Fast-acting, slow-acting, undetectable. I stock all three, and I do not ask what you need them for.
org_mount_vendor: Grosk Wolfrider. The wolf pens are here in the south-east of the city, downwind of everybody, by request. Every orc worth the name rides a wolf. I make sure the wolves are worth it too.
org_riding_trainer: Zhurak, riding instructor. I teach at the pens in the south-east quarter, beside Grosk and his wolves. Sit tall, lean into the turn, and never show a wolf you are afraid. Ready to learn?
org_stable_master_2: Kessa Trailrunner. South-east stables, by the east wall. Feed, water, rest. The same three things every mount needs and the same three things half its riders forget. Leave yours with me.
org_alchemist_2: Tolga, brewmaster. South of the market, on the way to the gate. Every potion is a promise, and mine keep theirs. Zurm across the city will tell you his are stronger. Zurm's customers come to me afterwards.
org_tailor: Ilyenne Threadweave. I sew south of the market, on the east side of the gate road. Cloth does not stop a blade. It stops the cold, though, and the cold has killed as many as blades have. Sit down. Let me see how that hangs on you.
org_leatherworker: Sarnda Hidecraft. My racks are by the south gate, where the hunters come in from Durotar with the day's skins. Bring me hide and I will bring you armour. Bring me good hide and I will bring you armour worth wearing.
org_supplies: Ragnok Packmule. Last stop before the south gate and Durotar. Rope, saddlebags, feed sacks. Not glamorous. Everyone who walked out of that gate without them has come back to tell me I was right, or has not come back.
ct_org: Garrek. I train every discipline, here beside the inn. I have taught each of them at one time or another and I am not precious about which you picked. The specialists are scattered round the walls if you want a second opinion. Show me where you are, and bring gold.
pt_org_forge: Brakka. Mining and smithing, on the north-east side. Ore in one hand, hammer in the other. I teach both halves or neither, because there is no sense knowing where to dig if you cannot do anything with it. The city forge is across town on the west side, beside Krunk.
pt_org_herbs: Shazra, apothecary. North wall, east of the mages. Every weed is a medicine to someone. I will show you which to pull and what to do with it after, and the second part is where people go wrong.
pt_org_wood: Bruga, woodwright. I teach just north of the market. Fell it, saw it, make something of it. A plank is only a bow that has not happened yet. The sawmill is over on the west side by the forge, and you will want it.
pt_org_hide: Thurgan, tanner. North side, west of the inn. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - it all comes across my bench. Pay once and I will teach you the lot of it, cooking included, because a hunter who cannot cook is just carrying food about.
pt_org_essence: They call me Tinker Brakka, so nobody mixes me up with the smith. I work west of the inn. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. Bring me the first two and I will see about the third.
